decision_rule: Compare best-of-16 legalised sizes. If harden-half reaches <= 4.001 while harden-quarter does not (gap > 0.01), the basin is found in the first half of the morph. If both reach it, even a quarter-morph suffices and the critical interval is tau in [0, 0.25]. If neither reaches it, the full morph path is needed and the checkpoint result (tau~0.5) stands as the localization. Descriptive; feeds the mechanism story, no confirmatory claim.
hypothesis: harden-half (tau0=0.5) reaches the ltri n=5 pinwheel (L<=4.001) but harden-quarter (tau0=0.25) does not: the basin is found in the first half of the morph, consistent with the tau~0.5 checkpoint handoff.
question: How much of the morph path is needed to reach the ltri n=5 pinwheel basin?
title: Morph-fraction ablation on ltri n=5
